svg.title: Sharding an inverted index by term versus by document
svg.desc: By term: the query world cup goes to the shard holding all of world and the shard holding all of cup, which must ship a whole list to intersect; a new post writes to every shard holding one of its terms. By document: the query goes to all three shards, each intersects its own lists and returns its top 25; a new post writes to one shard.
svg.text: one shard per word, but they must swap lists,
and one post writes to up to 30 shards
every shard gets the query, intersects its own
lists and returns its top 25; nothing is shipped
